parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Court-road (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 16.8 | 2.56 | 2.56
2 | 73.3 | 10.4 | 12.9
3 | 701 | 49.9 | 62.9
4 | 51.6 | 51.4 | 114
5 | 99.8 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Court-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KH-type
Aquifer depth: 62.9–114 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive (51.6 ohm-m) layer between 62.9 m and 114 m depth as the main aquifer zone; drill through the overlying resistive layer (701 ohm-m, 12.9–62.9 m) with appropriate casing to prevent collapse, and confirm water strike with cuttings/geophysical logging as drilling approaches 60 m.
